answer: Posted collateral must equal 7 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. Because the ridge collateral is checked against the jade claim at intake, the vault audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases hence has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. That is 9 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
